sourceFindings.finding: HoldPublication is a real SQLite transaction. entered is set in precommit after begin_update, SQL mutations and state_meta writes, before COMMIT and authority publish. Its release flag only permits continuation; it does not acknowledge either COMMIT or publication. After release, the held real commit/publication must finish before the only writer can run Start.

Second publication waits for entered, then spawns a helper which sleeps 10 ms and releases; Start runs on the scoped caller. There is no request-specific admission handshake. Sleep is neither a maximum release delay nor proof that Start observed Updating or was successfully enqueued before release. Its helper could be delayed, or could release before Start is scheduled.

Start on Updating deliberately bypasses VoiceService::actor() polling and queues the exact original lease. The actor-loop 100 ms deadline is relevant to other status/publish paths, but is not the direct deadline for this Start. repository_mode supplies the unchanged production 100 ms voice timeout.

Positive Start active closure captures real std::time::Instant + 100 ms before enqueue; it is checked before enqueue, at writer evaluate, and immediately before commit. Ticket recv_timeout starts after successful enqueue with another 100 ms duration. This elapsed-time safety budget includes queue residence and real writer work; fixture ClockFixture date and monotonic_millis=0 do not freeze it. The two deadlines start at slightly different instants.

Indeterminate (including ticket timeout or expired active), AuthorityUnavailable, PublicationFailed and WorkerPanicked all map to VoiceRepositoryError::Faulted. conclude then invalidates the runtime epoch/admission. This label alone does not prove global HealthGate Faulted, SQL commit failure, disk slowness, or which deadline/authorization check failed.

Start rechecks original job authorization/class and exact session against identity read in the same writer transaction; precommit checks again. Precommit error causes rollback plus authority rollback; a ticket timeout by itself cannot establish rollback or undo an already-started commit. Preserve fail-closed generation fencing and reconcile unknown results, without automatic positive retries.

Windows fixture uses ordinary TEMP and real SQLite WAL + synchronous FULL (busy_timeout 250 ms); no fake disk or frozen elapsed clock is used. VOICE_FIXTURE serializes this tests module, not the complete backend/Web suite. No contention duration or physical disk latency is present in the failure report. Source comments mention Linux-only tmpfs; that is not evidence about Windows root cause.

queued_bytes() already exists and accounting is removed at writer pop. While HoldPublication blocks the sole private writer, zero baseline plus one new Start producer makes positive queued bytes evidence that Start reached queue-budget reservation. But reserve increments before sender.try_send: the metric is not an exact successful-send acknowledgement.

fixtureRecommendations.name: Exact post-send coordination, if a narrowly scoped admission observer is accepted
fixtureRecommendations.proposal: Keep HoldPublication entered/AuthorityUpdating barrier. Observe the exact matching Start only after successful try_transaction admission, immediately release its private HoldPublication flag from that observer, then perform the existing production wait. Observer must be per-repository/request-scoped, nonblocking and atomic-only, with no SQL/reentry; install through test support rather than a global callback. Maintain the real Windows TEMP/WAL/FULL writer, production 100 ms, original exact lease, Starting/zero-repeat and real class-binding revocation assertions. Capture admission/release/evaluate/precommit/commit/result phase times for diagnosis.
fixtureRecommendations.why: Removes the arbitrary 10 ms helper sleep and proves actual admission while the writer is in the publication barrier.
fixtureRecommendations.limitation: There is no exact post-send observer in the current API. A cfg(test) item only in dependency fc-storage is not automatically available to bootstrap unit tests: implementation needs correctly scoped test-support wiring or an existing composition seam, not an assumed callable API. Even exact admission cannot guarantee real disk/OS completion within 100 ms.

fixtureRecommendations.name: Smallest fixture-only improvement using existing queue accounting
fixtureRecommendations.proposal: For the second private HoldPublication only, assert queued_bytes baseline zero while entered and no other producer is active; replace the separate sleep10ms releaser with a bounded precommit wait which releases immediately when the one positive Start producer makes queued_bytes exceed baseline. Keep Release RAII cleanup and fail rather than silently accepting its outer diagnostic timeout. Keep every existing success/binding assertion and unchanged real disk/100 ms limits.
fixtureRecommendations.why: Requires no production API or timeout change; Start has already passed the Updating snapshot branch and established active deadline when its descriptor reserves queue bytes. Removes fixed-delay scheduling as the coordination mechanism.
fixtureRecommendations.limitation: Call this queue-reservation handshake, not post-send admission or writer execution. Accounting precedes try_send; release can occur before send if the caller is preempted between them. It improves semantic overlap evidence and removes a scheduled releaser, but does not prove an exact channel-send event or hard real-time success.
